result:
Round 237 is a **FAIL**. The three target bugs are fixed in the real browser, but the round causes a new Medium bug: the status line can get stuck on "Loading the demo collection…" after loading has finished. A flagged this as a STOP; I reproduced it on my own in real Chromium at both viewports. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true; the one blocked row only needs the backend.

**C-R237-01 (Medium, same bug as A's A-R237-REVIEW-M1):**
- **Steps:** delay both demo MP3s by 6 s. While the status still says loading, press a Volume fader, move it 4 px and press Ctrl+Z. The "Undo/Redo does not work while dragging" message shows. Keep holding until loading finishes, then release.
- **This round:** after the release, the status goes back to "Loading the demo collection…" and stays there, although every library row already shows its duration.
- **Old code (`ecaf0e4`) on a second server, same script:** the status ends on the "Demo collection ready…" text. So this round caused it.
- **A's candidate fix** (`a-round-237/candidate-fix.diff`) is not applied and I did not test it. B should rule on it together with A's reviewer note L1 (the same kind of problem, which I did not reproduce in the browser).
- **Doc 185 line 4** already says "Completed (C round 237 PASS)", which is now false. The fix-up must allow that line to change and add an M1 problem/solution entry.

**What passed (both 1440×900 and 1280×720):**

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| Scope | Only the 9 allowed files plus the 2 new files changed. Frozen files, root files and protected files are untouched. |
| Unit tests | 10 files, 116 tests green. |
| MU-RC mutant | Run on a scratch copy: TU9 and TU10 go red. The repo is unchanged. |
| Delay race (the original bug) | The Add status (placement + tempo + Snap) survives the ready write, with no leading space. The old code still shows the bare ready text, as expected. |
| Fail race | Shows exactly the "1 sound … failed to load" text on one line, and the library row shows the 404 error. |
| Idle load | "Loading…", then the exact ready text, then the seed text. |
| Placement (SFX, no tempo) | The final status is exactly that clip's placement text; tempo and Snap are not touched. |
| GATE234-S2 (seed search closes) | Unit only: TQ1 green. MU-S2 red comes from A's report; I did not re-run it. |
| Round-236 ruler rows | A strip click at 4.1 s starts the audio at offset 4.0. A strip double-click plays with no Fit. A double-click lower on the ruler gives the exact Fit text. A click at 15.95 s shows the exact "past the end" text and does not play. Space then plays from 0. |
| Screen budget | Permanent text lines are identical to the old code (empty and seeded project). |
| Smoke | Space plays and pauses. WAV export: 48 kHz, 24-bit, stereo, exactly 16.000 s, no NaN samples, identical file hash at both viewports. 0 page errors. |
| Auth | `/studio-lab` opens with no sign-in and `auth_user` empty. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio. The token API returns 401 with no header and 500 with a fake token, the same as round 236. No bypass. |
| Docs and backlog | "No reference found" is stated with its search. `SABA-Q-READY-AFTER-ACTION` is `awaiting_user`. The deferred Lows are in `deferred_low_polish`. The doc 183 `playFromRuler` text matches the code. |

The screen-reader status line does not repeat its announcement when loading finishes after an Add: my observer saw no change at that moment.

**Not claimed:** the full test suite, typecheck, lint, build, verify and e2e smoke are left to the root gate. The purchased-product version can't be checked in the cloud because there is no backend.

I made no source edits; the store `git status` is the same as when I started. The extra server I ran for the old-code comparison is stopped, and its copy (with the mutant copy) stays in `/tmp` as evidence.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-237.md`
- `c-round-237.json`
- `c-round-237/` (scripts, screenshots and logs; `race.cjs` re-runs the bug check)
